recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of seven men in late 1970s/early 1980s attire, positioned in the lower half of the frame against a dramatic sunset horizon that transitions into a deep blue-black sky. A large, stylized script logo floats above them, accompanied by a bright, four-pointed lens flare on one figure's shoulder.
coreVisualRelationships: The band members form a horizontal anchor in the lower third of the composition.
The large script logo creates a diagonal counter-balance to the group's arrangement.
The sunset glow provides a warm backlighting that separates the subjects from the dark upper background.
coreInvariants: A soft, airbrushed circular glow behind the central subjects.
A prominent, sharp four-pointed yellow lens flare.
A high-contrast transition from warm orange horizon to cool navy sky.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Seven figures in a medium-long shot, occupying the bottom 50% of the frame, arranged in a slightly staggered row.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a grey blazer and red shirt acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright lens flare, moves left across the faces, then upward to the large diagonal script logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper 40% of the image is dominated by a dark, textured gradient sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange and yellow (sunset horizon and lens flare).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark sky and the bright sunset glow; muted, naturalistic tones in the clothing (denim, leather, wool).
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors; stick to film-emulation palettes.

letterConstructionRules: Main logo uses a thick, connected cursive script with a heavy drop shadow.
Secondary text uses a wide, tracked-out geometric sans-serif.
The script features rounded terminals and a consistent 30-degree upward slant.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' in the second word is oversized and serves as a container for the following letters.
Double-line inline effect on the script strokes.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a fluid, heavy script with a rigid, airy geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The red/white/black color scheme of the logo
The wide tracking of the top text
avoid: Vertical alignment for the main logo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, connected retro energy.
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked metadata style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of seven men in 1970s casual attire (denim, leather jackets, blazers) standing in a row. The background is a sunset with a warm orange glow at the horizon transitioning into a deep navy blue sky. A bright, four-pointed yellow lens flare is positioned on the shoulder of one man. The overall image has a soft, grainy film texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white script logo with a thick red and black outline at a 15-degree upward angle in the upper center. Add a line of wide-spaced, small uppercase sans-serif text across the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the lens flare sharp and four-pointed?
Does the sky have a smooth gradient from orange to navy?
Is the main logo tilted diagonally?
Are the men's clothes appropriate for the late 70s era?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any specific brand logos on clothing

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn quality to the script lettering

postGenerationChecks: Verify the lens flare does not obscure faces.
Ensure the script logo has a visible drop shadow or multi-stroke outline.
Check that the top text is evenly spaced across the width.
Confirm the color palette feels grounded in 1980s analog photography.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a group portrait in period-correct attire with a dual-tone atmospheric sky and a heavy, slanted retro script logo for a classic rock aesthetic.
